mapper.select: SELECT D.CO_CD , D.TMPLAT_ID , D.WBS_PLAN_CODE_ID , D.WBS_PLAN_CODE_NM , D.START_OFFSET , D.END_OFFSET , NVL(D.DAYCNT, 0) AS DAYCNT , NVL(D.PLAN_MH, 0) AS PLAN_MH , NVL(D.OUT_YN, 'N') AS OUT_YN , NVL(D.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN , NVL(D.SORT_ORD, 1) AS SORT_ORD , D.RMK FROM TB_WB30D01 D WHERE D.CO_CD = #{coCd} AND D.TMPLAT_ID = #{tmplatId} ORDER BY NVL(D.SORT_ORD, 999), D.WBS_PLAN_CODE_ID
